units.source_text: ‘人之子啊，消除、消除、消除你心中的憎惡吧’，

en.t: O son of man, erase, erase, erase the hatred in your heart,

units.source_text: 古代的波斯語裡還有‘給悲傷疲憊的心靈帶來希望的，

en.t: and in ancient Persian there is also this: the only thing that brings hope to a sorrow-weary heart,

units.source_text: 就只有帶來微醺的玉杯’。

en.t: is the jade cup that brings a gentle intoxication.
You silly girl, watch out or I will kiss you.

units.source_text: 她一點也不害羞地噘起了嘴脣。

en.t: Without the least embarrassment, she puckered her lips.

units.source_text: 「傻丫頭，一點貞操觀念都沒有……」

en.t: You silly girl, you have no sense of chastity at all...

units.source_text: 不過，良子的表情中，明顯散發出沒被任何人玷汙過的處女氣息。

en.t: And yet, in Yoshiko's expression there was clearly the air of a virgin who had never been defiled by anyone.

units.source_text: 翌年初一個嚴寒的夜晚，我醉醺醺地去買菸，

en.t: Early the next year, on a bitterly cold night, I went out drunk to buy cigarettes,

units.source_text: 不小心掉進了香菸店前的下水道洞口裡，

en.t: and accidentally fell into the sewer opening in front of the tobacco shop,

units.source_text: 我連聲呼叫：「良子，良子，拉我一把，拉我一把。」

en.t: and I called out again and again: Yoshiko, Yoshiko, pull me up, pull me up.
